dedupe_keys.name: data electrical conductivity rainfall depth water level and turbidity registered at bologna wastewater treatment plant from mid may to december 2024

description: The Bologna wastewater-treatment depositor publishes four Excel workbooks free under Zenodo CC BY 4.0. Their filenames identify rainfall depth, water level, electrical conductivity and turbidity monitored at the treatment plant from mid-May to December 2024. These co-located series can calibrate wet-weather inflow and quality-response components in wastewater simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Bologna monitoring release. Coverage is one treatment-plant setting and the stated months; the public page contains no description beyond the title. Sensor locations, sampling cadence, units, maintenance events and missing-value codes are therefore uncertain until workbook columns are examined. Conductivity and turbidity alone do not identify all pollutants or system failures. No workbook was downloaded, time series aligned or event response estimated.
